candidates.prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on white for reading from a tag buffer a value of datatype U64. Across the TOP place exactly U64 in HUGE BOLD BLACK characters with large WHITE GAPS between each character. Capital I, if present, MUST have broad horizontal top and bottom bars, clearly different from digit 1. The exact label U64 must dominate the image and remain legible at 30x18 pixels. No other text, no shadows. Below the type show a large BLUE rectangular buffer and a bold ORANGE horizontal arrow pointing AWAY from the buffer. The arrow must clearly show data going out of the buffer. Center the entire design within the square.

signature.composition: Below the type show a large BLUE rectangular buffer and a bold ORANGE horizontal arrow pointing AWAY from the buffer. The arrow must clearly show data going out of the buffer.
